capabilities: chat with an assistant that searches, reads and lists notes, folders, Bases and Canvas files
require approval before any write, move, edit or delete outside its own folder
manage memory and skills as editable Markdown notes, including pinned and on-demand skills
carry working context such as the open note, open tabs or meaning-related notes into a conversation
run per-conversation tasks with chosen skills, tools and context
extras: Local model servers need CORS enabled (the connection test passes without it but chat fails); full documentation, getting-started guide and troubleshooting live on an external documentation site; models without native tool calling work only through a less reliable text fallback.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in chat assistant that can look up, read and edit vault notes itself while keeping writes under user control and data local.

relations.evidence: With Vault Retrieval installed, Koda adds search by meaning
any other model gets the text recognised by Image to Markdown
generate_image asks Local Image Generator for a picture
Claude (Anthropic API) works through the LLM Endpoint Manager

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (e.g. LM Studio, Ollama, or a hosted provider)
API key for a hosted provider or Anthropic Claude
Vault Retrieval, Image to Markdown, Local Image Generator, LLM Endpoint Manager

summary: Agentic chat companion that searches, reads and, with your approval, writes vault notes using an OpenAI-compatible model you choose.
